STRATEGIC.label: nav-COMPLIANCE — the emitted BEHAVIOUR follows the route command (imminent windows)
STRATEGIC.detail: no nav-compliance readout was passed to this NavSim artifact. NavSim's own score never measures behaviour against the command; the readout needs the plan under TRUE / SHUFFLED / ZERO command conditionings on the same scenes (taniteval/taniteval/nav_compliance.py). ⚠️ The command is an ORACLE route (ROUTE_LEAK_VERDICT), so a compliance rate reads route-FOLLOWING given the expert's route, never route choice.
